Name: AGI Keys
Description: Mac-only Codex Micro compatible controls for Stream Deck, with live task status and usage.

com.dualform.agikeys.agent-1.Name: Agent 1 (Slot 1)
com.dualform.agikeys.agent-1.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 1 and brings Codex to the foreground.

com.dualform.agikeys.agent-2.Name: Agent 2 (Slot 2)
com.dualform.agikeys.agent-2.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 2 and brings Codex to the foreground.

com.dualform.agikeys.agent-3.Name: Agent 3 (Slot 3)
com.dualform.agikeys.agent-3.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 3 and brings Codex to the foreground.

com.dualform.agikeys.agent-4.Name: Agent 4 (Slot 4)
com.dualform.agikeys.agent-4.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 4 and brings Codex to the foreground.

com.dualform.agikeys.agent-5.Name: Agent 5 (Slot 5)
com.dualform.agikeys.agent-5.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 5 and brings Codex to the foreground.

com.dualform.agikeys.agent-6.Name: Agent 6 (Slot 6)
com.dualform.agikeys.agent-6.Tooltip: Selects Codex Micro agent slot 6 and brings Codex to the foreground.

com.dualform.agikeys.dial-agent.Name: Dial · Agent selection
com.dualform.agikeys.dial-agent.Tooltip: Use the Stream Deck+ dial to move through Codex Micro agent candidates, then press or touch to bring the selected agent to the foreground. Touch-and-hold behavior can be configured.

com.dualform.agikeys.dial-reasoning.Name: Dial · Reasoning level
com.dualform.agikeys.dial-reasoning.Tooltip: Adjust the Codex Micro reasoning level by rotating the Stream Deck+ dial. Press or touch to send an encoder click; long-touch behavior can be configured.

com.dualform.agikeys.dial-conversation.Name: Dial · Left/right control
com.dualform.agikeys.dial-conversation.Tooltip: Sends the native left/right control configured in Codex Micro. Press or touch to send an encoder click; long-touch behavior can be configured.

com.dualform.agikeys.fast.Name: ACT06 · Physical key
com.dualform.agikeys.fast.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT06 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.approve.Name: ACT07 · Physical key
com.dualform.agikeys.approve.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT07 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.decline.Name: ACT08 · Physical key
com.dualform.agikeys.decline.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT08 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.fork.Name: ACT09 · Physical key
com.dualform.agikeys.fork.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT09 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.dictation.Name: ACT10 · Physical key
com.dualform.agikeys.dictation.Tooltip: Sends key-down and key-up to physical position ACT10 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.act11.Name: ACT11 · Physical key
com.dualform.agikeys.act11.Tooltip: Sends key-down and key-up to physical position ACT11 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.send.Name: ACT12 · Physical key
com.dualform.agikeys.send.Tooltip: Sends physical position ACT12 in Codex Micro. The action and key image follow the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.plan.Name: JOY_UP · Physical direction
com.dualform.agikeys.plan.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_UP in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.back.Name: JOY_LEFT · Physical direction
com.dualform.agikeys.back.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_LEFT in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.forward.Name: JOY_RIGHT · Physical direction
com.dualform.agikeys.forward.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_RIGHT in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.sidebar.Name: JOY_DOWN · Physical direction
com.dualform.agikeys.sidebar.Tooltip: Sends physical direction JOY_DOWN in Codex Micro. The action follows the current assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.reasoning.Name: ENC_CLK · Physical press
com.dualform.agikeys.reasoning.Tooltip: Sends physical position ENC_CLK in Codex Micro. The action follows the current encoder assignment in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.reasoning-down.Name: Action · Lower reasoning level
com.dualform.agikeys.reasoning-down.Tooltip: Lowers the Codex Composer reasoning level by one step.

com.dualform.agikeys.reasoning-up.Name: Action · Raise reasoning level
com.dualform.agikeys.reasoning-up.Tooltip: Raises the Codex Composer reasoning level by one step.

com.dualform.agikeys.new-task.Name: Action · New task
com.dualform.agikeys.new-task.Tooltip: Opens a new task in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.usage-limit.Name: Usage · Remaining
com.dualform.agikeys.usage-limit.Tooltip: Shows the remaining Codex usage. Five-hour and weekly views can be configured. The Codex action on press can be configured per key.

com.dualform.agikeys.usage-overview.Name: Usage · Five-hour / weekly
com.dualform.agikeys.usage-overview.Tooltip: Shows five-hour and weekly Codex usage at the same time. The Codex action on press can be configured per key.

com.dualform.agikeys.rate-limit-reset.Name: Usage · Reset
com.dualform.agikeys.rate-limit-reset.Tooltip: Shows available usage reset credits. Hold for 1.2 seconds when eligible to consume one credit.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-new-task.Name: Keycap · New chat
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-new-task.Tooltip: Opens a new chat in native Codex Micro.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-reasoning-up.Name: Keycap · Increase reasoning
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-reasoning-up.Tooltip: Increases the current Composer reasoning level.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-reasoning-do.Name: Keycap · Decrease reasoning
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-reasoning-do.Tooltip: Decreases the current Composer reasoning level.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-openai-docs.Name: Keycap · OpenAI docs
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-openai-docs.Tooltip: Opens the official OpenAI developer documentation.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-download.Name: Keycap · Copy chat as Markdown
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-download.Tooltip: Copies the current conversation as Markdown.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-pin.Name: Keycap · Pin chat
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-pin.Tooltip: Toggles pinning for the current chat.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-play.Name: Keycap · Run primary action
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-play.Tooltip: Runs the first configured environment action.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-git-commit.Name: Keycap · Commit or push
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-git-commit.Tooltip: Opens the native Codex Git commit action.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-branch.Name: Keycap · Create draft PR
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-branch.Tooltip: Opens the draft PR creation flow in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-merge.Name: Keycap · Merge PR
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-merge.Tooltip: Opens the PR merge flow in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-pull-request.Name: Keycap · Create PR
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-pull-request.Tooltip: Opens the native Codex PR creation flow.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-add-photos.Name: Keycap · Add photos
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-add-photos.Tooltip: Adds photos to the current Composer.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-add-files.Name: Keycap · Attach files
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-add-files.Tooltip: Attaches files or folders to the current Composer.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-mic.Name: Keycap · Push to talk (large)
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-mic.Tooltip: Starts Codex voice input while pressed.

com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-create-branc.Name: Keycap · Create branch
com.dualform.agikeys.keycap-create-branc.Tooltip: Opens the branch creation flow in Codex.

com.dualform.agikeys.dial-commands.Name: Dial · Select action
com.dualform.agikeys.dial-commands.Tooltip: Rotate to choose an action and press to run it.

com.dualform.agikeys.dial-usage.Name: Dial · Usage
com.dualform.agikeys.dial-usage.Tooltip: Rotate to switch between five-hour and weekly remaining usage, then press to refresh.

com.dualform.agikeys.dial-model.Name: Dial · Model
com.dualform.agikeys.dial-model.Tooltip: Rotate to change the model. The current model is shown on the display.

com.dualform.agikeys.context-compaction.Name: Context compaction
com.dualform.agikeys.context-compaction.Tooltip: Shows observed context usage for the current Codex task and requests native compaction on press.

com.dualform.agikeys.side-to-main.Name: Move side input to main
com.dualform.agikeys.side-to-main.Tooltip: Moves unsent side-chat text into an empty main input field without sending it.

com.dualform.agikeys.global-dictation.Name: Voice input · Shortcut PTT
com.dualform.agikeys.global-dictation.Tooltip: Records the shortcut used to toggle recording in settings. Sends once on press and once on release. Use while recording is stopped.
